name: Lake Agnes Teahouse and Big Beehive
why: Up through the forest from Lake Louise to a teahouse of 1901 on a hanging lake, then along the ridge to the Big Beehive, with Lake Louise far below.
book: Parks Canada Lake Louise shuttle reservation (reservation.pc.gc.ca), or arrive before 7:00 for the paid Lake Louise parking. The teahouse takes cash only and is open from June to early October.
water: Tea and water at the Lake Agnes Teahouse in season; none above it.
dangers: Avalanche terrain from November to mid-May: do not go.
Steep drop at the Big Beehive lookout.
